name: AGENTS.md
summary: AGENTS.md is a plain Markdown file at the root of a repository (or in subfolders) that tells coding agents how to build, test and follow the project's conventions. It has no required fields; agents read the nearest file to the code they edit. It started in August 2025 from OpenAI Codex, Amp, Jules, Cursor and Factory and is now a project of the Agentic AI Foundation under the Linux Foundation.
facts: Codex, Cursor, Jules, Amp, Gemini CLI, Copilot coding agent, Claude Code, Pi and others
Nearest file to the edited code wins; chat prompts override
goodFor: One instruction file shared across many coding agents
Build, test and style commands for agents
watchOut: No schema, so tools interpret content differently
Some tools prefer their own file (e.g. CLAUDE.md wins over AGENTS.md in Claude Code)
Long files cost context on every session
